ruleDefinitions.name: HackTool - SharPersist Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of the hacktool SharPersist - used to deploy various different kinds of persistence mechanisms

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\SharPersist\\\.exe$") OR process_product = "SharPersist") OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-t\\ schtask\\ \\-c\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-t\\ startupfolder\\ \\-c\\ .*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-t\\ reg\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m\\ add.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-t\\ service\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m\\ add.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-t\\ schtask\\ \\-c\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-m\\ add.*")))
